justification: Read the passage and all five question sets against elf-b19-001 and elf-b20-001 end to end, then diffed mechanically. Genre and temperature are strong: real concrete residue (the hardbacked book in four hands, the mill that stopped in 1931, a bar that has moved twice since 2011, an orifice packed with gravel and still packed), a genuine complication rather than a settled fact, and digressions that go nowhere for the questions (the trout that run in November, the three winters the weir drowned out). justification: Judged as a cloze under the owner's 2026-07-24 scope rule: the gap format, the gap notation and the single-lexical-item option sets are out of jurisdiction and are not findings. Everything else was judged as for any candidate. The passage is strong commentary prose - it opens on a smell, carries a field simile that fixes it inland, and closes mid-scene on a man carrying a standard lamp to a car watched by the woman who brought it. Concrete residue is real and functionless for the questions (the curtain hooks on the same trestle since ten, the coat that came in at four and went in eleven minutes, being wrong about one in four). I verified the four explicit bars independently and all four hold: the byline is bare (no columnist-credential frame), the excluded theme is absent (there is no notice, rota, list, bylaw or published rule anywhere in the passage, and the one change that is made is made without a word and complied with completely), the setting is inland, and there is no money arithmetic (one price, two pounds, never summed with anything). Passage-only n-gram diff against every shipped ELF unit tops out at n=4 on function words. The flag is lane clustering the brief did not bar and the generator's clone_note did not reach: the fourth consecutive instance of the family's operative hinge, the second consecutive practitioner-with-a-tenure-figure, and a framing sentence shared with two concurrently generated siblings.

findings: REGISTER OUTLIER, the batch's strongest single authenticity finding: 70 per cent of the passage's characters sit inside quotation marks. Two of the passage's three paragraphs are pure quotation with no attributive and no narration. The result reads as a sidebar Q&A or an interview extract rather than an excerpt from a magazine feature, which is the genre the exemplar range establishes. This is the outcome the brief itself predicted for this slot, verbatim: 'Three simultaneous binding constraints on one lane slot is the point at which a lane brief usually starts producing strained units.'

justification: Read the passage against the three preceding TYPE-001 shorts (elf-b18-003, elf-b19-003, elf-b20-003) end to end. The three lane constraints are all discharged and I verified each on the bytes: the quoted voice is present with contractions ('won't shift', 'there's no tape left', 'the sheet's gone'); the subject leaves the domestic building envelope entirely for paper conservation, with no wall, roof, mortar, chimney or damp anywhere; and no surname ends in -by, -ius or -vall. The key is C, which breaks the D-A-D-A-D run the brief named, and I confirmed the key. The mechanism is real and correctly stated (rubber adhesive oxidising brown, plasticiser migrating into the sheet and making it translucent, fresh mends lifting with heat while aged ones need a solvent matched to the adhesive, staining reducible but not removable), and the concrete residue is genuine (a tea towel, 'about 1974', three flakes of film, a hard brown band the width of the strip). Passage-only n-gram diff against every shipped ELF unit tops out at n=4 on function words, and the unit's own phrase grep of sixteen distinctive strings is honest about which generic bigrams hit. The flag is the quotation fraction: on every other dimension this sits inside the exemplar range, but 70 per cent quoted against a bank maximum of 25 puts the genre outside it, and adjudication should decide whether an interview-extract shape is one the provpass can carry.

Longest ELF short in the bank at 237 mech tokens against a previous maximum of 201 (elf-b20-004), self-disclosed with the tokenizer's contribution accounted for. Well inside the authentic band of 101-368, so recorded rather than flagged on its own.
justification: Checked both lane axes on the bytes and both break. OFFICER-PAID-PER-ITEM: fully and verifiably gone. The last four TYPE-002 shorts each turned on a functionary - elf-b16-004's pinder living on fines, elf-b18-004's churchwardens, elf-b19-004's keeper at threepence an hour, elf-b20-004's town clerk at twopence an enrolment, which closes that unit with 'The clerk set his fee of two shillings against each enrolment'. This passage contains no clerk, keeper, pinder, warden or officer of any kind; every register verb is agentless passive ('The mark cont. was written against the entry', 'nothing was charged', 'The slate was rubbed clean every week and no copy of it was kept', 'every loan entered with its dates out and in'), and the only money is the subscribers' guinea and the overdue penny. COUNTED-REGISTER-WITH-AN-ANOMALOUS-SUBSET: broken as the inferential move. elf-b18-004 infers from six vacant pews, elf-b19-004 from two hatch openings, elf-b20-004 from five boys bound twice; this unit infers from the RENEWAL column and from the renewals that are absent, given a rule that makes continuation free and automatic, so a fourteenth-day return is a forfeited entitlement and the ledger silently preserves what the destroyed slate recorded. That is a different kind of inference, and it is the better one. Passage-only n-gram diff against every shipped ELF unit returns a single 4-gram ('in each of the'). Period detail holds on audit (a guinea a year, one volume at a time, a fortnight, a penny a day, purchases chosen by a small committee, a want-list slate rubbed out, a hired room over a shop), and no book title is printed, which removes a law-16 surface rather than adding one. The flag is surface and disclosure, not authenticity or clone: a title shape law 15 caps, and a sibling-sweep statistic that is wrong for the reason the brief's CORRECTION section was written about.

justification: Read the passage against las-b18-001, las-b19-001 and las-b20-001 end to end, and separately against the retired las-b6-001. The coda bar IS met: the final paragraph closes on the herd walking the same path each June without being driven, behind an old cow that remembers the way, with the calves following - a live present-tense image, no remains, no legibility instruction, no count-uncertainty, no dating. RULE 20(a) is met on six of its seven frame elements: no furnace anywhere (the word 'ugn' does not occur), no experimental reconstruction, no low mounds with a pit, no named parish, a two-entry glossary rather than three or four, and no dating coda. Authenticity is the strongest in the batch: dense, unforced concrete texture (klovjesadel, mikaelitiden, three alnar of vadmal, a milk house built over the stream to keep cool, cheeses dried harder the further the fabod stood from the village), a real explanatory structure with a decisive turn (cheap imported grain and artificial fertiliser removed the reason, but the creamery paying cash by fat content every morning is what actually ended it), a genuine digression with its own qualification (the call carries the herd and the horn carries the people, and then 'Gransen var inte skarp'), and a scholar who states the weakness of his own comparison. Question style is HP-standard and options are paraphrase throughout. The flag is that three separate elements collide with las-b20-001, the immediately preceding unit in the same lane - a survival declarative, an exact quantifier phrase in the same slot, and a labour-drain motif that occurs nowhere else in the bank - plus the batch-internal 'star kvar' collision. None is lethal; together they are the shape surviving the topic ban, which is exactly what the batch20 gate lesson said to watch for.

justification: I tested the four-consecutive debatt cluster on every axis the batch20 gate named and every axis breaks, verified on the bytes rather than taken from the unit's own note. INSTITUTION: no kommun - the arena is a market association's own vote among torghandlare, and the only municipal trace is a 1969 decision in the past tense. DIRECTION: nothing is withdrawn and nothing is charged for; the writer wants a relocation made, and made whole. SETTING: no named outlying settlement, and in fact no toponym at all - I enumerated the capitalised tokens and the only proper nouns in the student layer are the two personal names. COUNTER-ARITHMETIC: the word 'kronor' does not occur anywhere in the unit; the figures are stall counts, two distances, a year and a vote, and the question's arithmetic (74 applicants against 58 pitches) is in stalls. NAMED COUNTERPART: none - the counter-voice is a vote total of 39 to 12, and the one other named figure, Gottfrid Runesson, is a walk-on holding pitch 1 on the placement map who neither speaks nor acts. NARROWED ASK: inverted - 'Ett provar vill jag anda inte ha' and 'Flytta hela marknaden, bada dagarna', which is the opposite of the lane's sliver-ask. CLOSING NAMND DATE: none - the passage stops on the boarded weighing house and the limes that now shade three of the rows. OPENING: a vote the writer lost, not 'the payment unit is the wrong unit'. Two axes go further than the bar required: the writer argues against her own trade after losing its vote, grants both of the majority's reasons in full, leaves one of them unanswered ('Det svaret har jag inte'), and discloses her own financial interest in the change before anyone can raise it - a stance configuration the lane has not used. The flag is entirely the phrase level: the situation is new, the argument is new, and two authorial disclaimer formulae came straight through from the unit immediately before it in the same lane.

Fourth consecutive bare-name byline in the lane, self-disclosed in carried_findings and recorded here rather than pressed.
justification: Read the passage against all five shipped essa-shorts (las-b16-003 through las-b20-003). The five-unit skeleton the brief named is broken on every element and I verified each on the bytes: there is no documentary corpus, no defunct firm or association, nothing is counted (the only figures in the whole passage are 'ett par dygn', 'tre vintrar', 'flera ar' and 'en tvaa'), there is no custodian and no holding institution, no document is read or quoted, and the coda quotes nothing. The evidence base is remembered custom plus a named informant and 'andra jag har fragat' - which is exactly one of the alternatives the brief offered ('an essay on a practice, a word, a place-type, a remembered custom'). The limits move survives only as one clause of shared not-knowing about the ORDER of two accepted causes ('Vad som kom forst vet varken jag eller Hilding'), not as a paragraph about what a material cannot answer. The residual echo I did test is the named figure who complicates the received account - b19-003's archivist proved the essayist wrong, and Hilding here says the visits had stopped long before the radiators arrived - but the two run in opposite directions (b19-003 concedes and closes the question; this one leaves it open) and the essay-with-an-informant is a genre staple rather than a lane tic. Authenticity is high: a real intellectual move (the room re-described as a reception room for errand-bearers who carried a judgement away, rather than a room of honour for the people one loved, so the disappearance follows from the errands ceasing to arrive in person), unforced concrete residue (the pelargon somebody went in to water, the cold that smells of ash, the neighbour left standing in the farstu with his cap in his hand, the overcoats in front of the television, the glass cabinet too big for the flat's hall), and quoted speech with real contractions. The flag is the within-batch collisions - the coda device shared with both Swedish siblings and the received-explanation template shared with two siblings - plus a stale sibling sweep and a second index that is genuinely still owed.
